Lāvaṇyacandra

Lāvaṇyamayī

Pt.. Karnataka Press, Dharwar, 1920.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1469.

Lāvaṇyamuni

Lāvaṇyalaharī
or °stotra on Durgā. by Keśava Bhaṭṭa Laugākṣī II, son of Ananta an. grandson of Keśava Bhaṭṭa. Alwar 2341. Extr. no. 665. BORI. 356 of 1895-98. Peters. VI. Extr. p. 28 (no. 356). RORI. XXI. 3883. Extr. p.. 749-50.
For more ref. see M. L. Wadekar, Keśava's Lāvaṇyalaharī: A Little known an. unpublished Laharī kāvya in Aspects of Mss. Studies, p.. 101-21.
--compiled by Bholānātha. RORI. XXII. 1706 . (in a collection).

Lāvaṇyalaharī
by Tirumalanātha alias Uttamanambi, son of Cakrarāja of 15 cent. of Srirangam. mentioned by Prativādibhayaṅkara in his C. on other two works named Ānandalaharī an. Saubhāgyalaharī.
See A. M. Sathakoparamanujacarya, [Page243-a.
Kumbhakonam Col Mag. 23 (1938-39) 26-¬28.; also AIOC. IX. 500-02. |26|242-243|

Lāvaṇyavatī
kāvya. by Kṣemendra. q. in his own works Aucityavicāracarcā an. Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa.
See Life an. works of Kṣemendra in Poona Ori. XVII. p. 30.

Lāvaṇyavijaya
disciple of Bhānuvijaya.
--Dravyasattarī or Dravyasaptatikā. Jain. See under the text.

L. D. Ser. 20. ii. 611. Extr. p. 73.

See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 544.

Lāvaṇyavijaya

Lāvaṇyaśarman
